subject.title: [Bug]: Agent / sessions_spawn tool_use can emit with no matching tool_result and no parent-visible signal — silent subagent drop (~3.8% historical rate)

question: What parent-visible terminal failure contract should OpenClaw use when a sessions_spawn or Agent subagent dies, times out, or cannot deliver completion back to the requester?
rationale: Current code has replay repair and durable failure state, but choosing an explicit synthetic tool_result versus a harness reminder affects model-facing transcript semantics, retries, delivery durability, and sibling session flows.

options.title: Synthetic error tool result
options.body: Inject a structured error tool_result tied to the original spawn call so the parent model sees the failure through the existing tool contract.

options.title: Harness reminder event
options.body: Surface a next-turn system or harness reminder for dropped completions without changing the persisted tool_result contract.

options.title: Narrow per-path fixes
options.body: Fix timeout and handoff bugs as separate reports while leaving the broader parent-visible contract unresolved.

recommendation.title: Synthetic error tool result
recommendation.body: Inject a structured error tool_result tied to the original spawn call so the parent model sees the failure through the existing tool contract.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc has the strongest recent history on silent subagent completion handoff and agent wait behavior.
